summary: Revoke an access token by deleting it in the UI or POSTing token=<value> to /o/revoke_token/ with the client_id (and client_secret for confidential apps); success returns 200 OK. ALLOW_OAUTH2_FOR_EXTERNAL_USERS is disabled by default, and tokens created while it was enabled are not revoked when it is disabled.
questions: How do I revoke an AAP OAuth token with curl?
Are external users' tokens revoked when I disable the setting?
How do I verify a token was revoked?

answer_card.title: Revoke an access token
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
curl -X POST -d "token=<access_token>" \
  -u "<client_id>:<client_secret>" \
  http://<gateway>/o/revoke_token/ -i
```
A `200 OK` means success; confirm the token is gone from `api/gateway/v1/tokens/`. You can also delete it in the UI or use `aap-gateway-manage revoke_oauth2_tokens`.
